sources.officialityEvidence: A current Directorate General of Immigration regional-office page on imigrasi.go.id, updated 24 August 2026, names Afghanistan, Cameroon, Guinea, Israel, Liberia, Niger, Nigeria, North Korea and Somalia as Calling Visa subjects requiring clearance before visa issuance.

sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Immigration Office page names Afghanistan, Israel, North Korea, Liberia, Nigeria and Somalia in its Calling Visa schedule, but omits Cameroon, Guinea and Niger, creating a current official schedule discrepancy.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Afganistan, Israel, Korea Utara, Liberia, Nigeria, Somalia.

sources.title: C1 Tourist Visitor Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The central Directorate General page describes the C1 visitor visa's tourism purposes but does not publish a nationality eligibility schedule or a Kosovo result; it cannot support a residual-country conclusion.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Dengan visa C1, anda dapat berkunjung ke Indonesia untuk berwisata
